summary: Iteration 3: tested the CEF multi-inverter feature end to end (backend checks, schema_cef PDF, catalog seed/CRUD/upload, catalog-files/attach, import fixes) and ran UI checks on the CEF editor, Catalog echipamente and the old modules. New backend suite test_cef_catalog.py: 14/14 passed. Old suite test_prosumator_docs.py: 21 passed, 1 skipped (AI not called). The only failure in the old suite came from an outdated test, which I fixed (it re-imported the same client+POD and the new 409 rule rejected it). In the UI, all requested flows work: add inverters, pick from catalog, add strings, battery own/shared, backup, apply proposals, live totals (17.63 kWp / 18 kW / 30.48 kWh / 38 panels), issue lists, grid anti checkbox, save and reopen keeps the CEF data, doc-schema_cef works, catalog-files section and idempotent attach work, catalog tabs/add/edit/upload/delete work, and all old pages load.

minor.issue: Existing equipment records of ZOLTAN ANTAL (pros_ref 3f6fd4d4...) have client_name=None, so the Echipamente 'Beneficiar' column shows '—'. Only new imports get client_name; old records were not backfilled.
Check-then-insert is not atomic. Two concurrent first GET /api/data/catalog calls for a new owner could seed the catalog twice (low probability).
Old 'schema' is rendered portrait (0 landscape pages). Not a regression, just noted.

ui_bugs.issue: When battery mode is set to 'Baterie comună', shared_battery_id is not auto-selected even when only one shared battery exists. The error 'bateria comună selectată nu există' shows until the user picks it manually.
For records configured only through the CEF editor, the 'Putere PV (kW)' column shows '—' because top-level power/inverter fields are not derived from cef on save (flatten is only used in docgen).

issues: The search input (w-[240px]) stretches to full width and wraps below the title; other module pages keep it compact on the right
The success toast covers the 'Model nou' button in the top-right

action_items: Backfill client_name on old equipment/works/mono records that have pros_ref (from the prosumator client_name)
Auto-select the first shared battery when battery_mode becomes 'shared' (or when only one exists)
On save, derive top-level power/inverter/panels fields from cef (e.g. use cef totals) so the list and other modules show values
Minor: fix the search input width on /catalog-echipamente; make seed_catalog atomic (e.g. upsert the settings flag first with a find_one_and_update guard)
critical_code_review_comments: EquipmentCatalog.save/remove and CatalogFiles.attach have no try/catch, so an API failure gives no toast and can cause an unhandled rejection
CefEditor posts /cef/check on every change after a 500 ms debounce, which is fine. Errors are swallowed silently, so the user is not told when the check fails
cef.check: iz() for single-phase uses a 1.15 approximation for 2 loaded conductors. The values are labelled indicative, which is acceptable

Leftover test data from earlier iterations is still in the DB: prosumator 'PROS-UI-1 UI Client X', a prosumator with empty number/name (id 7638ac84-...), and clients 'Test Client' and 'Test Client SRL'
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_prosumator_docs.py (dup-import test now uses a different POD because of the new 409 rule)
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted: TEST_CEF_* prosumators/clients/catalog items/documents, a temporary user test_cef_*@example.com (removed from Mongo with its catalog/settings), and UI record TEST_CEF_UI Client (PROS-2026-005). Deleted 'TEST CEF SCHEMA' prosumator and client as allowed. Temporarily uploaded a datasheet to the Solis catalog item, then reset it to null. ZOLTAN ANTAL is untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the suites serially: cd /app/backend && SKIP_AI=1 REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest tests/test_cef_catalog.py tests/test_prosumator_docs.py -n0. The prosumator form field client_name is a <select> of existing clients, so create the client first. Catalog has 14 seeded items. Do not delete all catalog items for the admin, because they do not re-seed; use a fresh registered user to test seeding.
rca of the issue: Old pytest failure: the test re-imported the same client_name+pod, and the new duplicate rule correctly returns 409. Fixed in the test.
